title: 주전도감과 해동통보
prompt: Educational textbook illustration in realistic light ink-and-watercolor washes, soft natural light, restrained harmonious colors and subtle paper texture. Carefully depict 고려 Korea of this period: period-appropriate architecture, clothing and tools. No readable text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks. No graphic violence or blood. Interior of a government coin-casting workshop seen from the far end of a long hall: clay furnaces glowing, workers in plain hemp clothes pouring molten bronze into stacked clay molds, others filing rough castings at low benches, steam and smoke drifting toward high wooden rafters, an official in a dark robe watching from a doorway. Finished coins appear only as tiny featureless bronze discs heaped in a distant wooden tray, too small and too far away to show any detail. Every coin, mold, tablet, sign, banner, placard, sheet of paper and box in the scene is completely plain and blank: no lettering, characters, glyphs, numerals, symbols or square holes rendered as marks of any script. No printing press, no clipboard, no modern tools. Landscape composition, requested 1536 x 1024 pixels, a single illustration. All faces are invented, with no recognizable likeness to real people or official standardized portraits. Composition correction for this retry: show the entire workshop only from a distant doorway, with a large completely empty floor in the foreground. Every worker and every workbench must be far away in the middle or background, with no close-up people or objects. Override the earlier visible-disc detail: all finished coins and rough coin castings are concealed inside completely closed plain wooden boxes; no coin faces or loose discs are visible anywhere. Workers handle the closed molds and furnace tools only. All clay mold surfaces are entirely smooth and unmarked, without decorative dots, perforation patterns, incisions or glyph-like textures.
basis: 고려사 식화지: 숙종 2년 12월 교서로 주전관을 세우고, 숙종 7년 주조한 돈 1만5천 관을 나누어 주며 거리 양쪽에 점포를 두어 돈을 쓰게 했다는 기사
caveats: 점포 거리와 주전 작업장의 모습은 표현이며 실측 복원이 아니다.
